title: LLM ingest -> conversion -> smoke -> publish versioned performance profile catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline that accepts new open-source LLM weights, performs automated conversion/quantization, runs deterministic smoke and regression tests, produces a canonical set of performance profiles (latency/throughput/memory across common seq lengths and hardware), and publishes a versioned profile entry to the model catalog with a recommended pin. The pipeline should be resilient, auditable, and produce actionable telemetry for the Console and Optimize tooling.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Pipeline can ingest weights from S3/HuggingFace/tarball with signed manifest and checksum verification.
2) Automated conversion produces runtime-compatible artifacts for CPU, CUDA FP16, and 4/8-bit quantized variants with consistent artifact naming.
3) Smoke suite validates model outputs on a canonical prompt set and rejects conversions with tokenization or obvious output regression.
4) Performance profiling job emits latency P50/P95, throughput, peak GPU/CPU memory, and kv-cache size across seq lengths [64,256,1024].
5) Catalog entry is created with semantic versioning (major.minor.variant), a recommended pin set, compatibility metadata, and a signed profile bundle.
6) Observability: tracing, ingest telemetry, and failure reasons surface in Console; alerts trigger on conversion failures >3 in 24h.
tasks:
1. Ingest: add signed-manifest handler and provenance records (S3/HF).
2. Conversion: extend converter to output quantized ggml/ONNX + runtime pin metadata.
3. Determinism: implement seeded-smoke harness for output-signature checks and tokenization diffs.
4. Profiling: run batched microbenchmarks across hardware matrices and gather telemetry.
5. Pin recommendation: simple heuristic engine (latency vs quality tradeoff) to suggest default pin.
6. Catalog publish: store profile JSON, artifact URIs, checksums, and release notes.
7. Integrations: add trace hooks for Console and Optimize, include links to PR and artifact URLs.
8. Security: KMS signing of manifests and ensure no private keys included.
9. E2E tests: CI workflow that runs a full sample model onboarding from ingest to catalog entry.
technical_notes:
- Use existing artifact-gateway as a starting point but add a manifest-level signing verification step and a provenance chain.
- Conversion will reuse weight-normalizer and quantization modules; ensure outputs follow runtime filename conventions so pinflow can map variants to kernel profiles.
- Smoke harness uses small deterministic prompt deck (10 prompts) and compares token sequence hashes to a golden baseline where available; flag any tokenization mismatch as FAIL.
- Profiling jobs should be containerized and parameterized by hardware profile (a100-80gb, rtx-6000, cpu-128) and sequence length. Store raw telemetry to long-term metrics store and derive summarized profile JSON.
- Pin naming: <model>-v<major>.<minor>-variant.<quant>. Example: pelican-v1.2-variant.tinyq4.
- Ensure conversion step writes out a compatibility matrix file that enumerates supported runtimes and kernel feature gates.
- Security: mark incoming community weights with 'untrusted' tag until acceptance gates pass; only then flip to 'certified' and publish pin.
- Rollback: if published profile fails regression checks post-publish, trigger an automatic revert with a rollback note and notify owners.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (canary): run pipeline in staging for a small set of curated OSS models and validate outputs with SE/REVIEW. Phase 2 (beta): enable for community-submitted weights with manual review step. Phase 3 (GA): fully automated admission and publish for models that pass all gates.
- Start with 5 models in canary, expand to 25 in beta.
- Disable automatic catalog publish by default for first two weeks to gather telemetry.
- Communicate to developer community via changelog and docs.
monitoring_and_alerting:
- Console dashboard tile showing ingest/conversion success rate, avg conversion time, and number of pending manual reviews.
- Alerts: conversion-failure-rate > 5% for 1h, smoke-failure > 0 for certified artifacts, profiling job queue latency > 15m.
- Telemetry: include artifact_id, job_id, dataset_hash, sequence_lengths tested, hardware tag, and profile_version in all metrics.
